purpose: Corresponding and reference source archives for redistributable third-party components used to build the Windows x64 portable release.

components.name: FFmpeg
components.source_tree_licenses: LGPL-2.1-or-later with optional GPL and other per-file licensed code not enabled in the distributed binary
components.notes: Exact complete upstream source used by the reproducible minimal shared build. The distributed binary was configured without --enable-gpl and --enable-nonfree; optional GPL source files remain in the unmodified corresponding-source archive.
